title: Computation of Year-End Interest on Cash Security Deposits
content:
**Security Deposits — the December 31 accrual of a calendar year on a cash deposit held in full for the whole year.**

## Calculation

1. **Accrued year.** The accrued year is the calendar year after the last accrual period on the deposit ledger ends, and its accrual period runs from January 1 through December 31 of that year.
2. **Cash held.** The cash held is the deposit payments posted on the deposit ledger less any refund or application posted on it.
3. **Member rate.** The member rate of a year-end accrual is the commission rate the tier's interest table gives for the accrued year.
4. **Days.** The accrual counts every day of the accrued year: 365, or 366 in a leap year.
5. **Interest.** The year-end interest is the cash held multiplied by the member rate in percent and divided by one hundred, multiplied by the days the year-end accrual counts and divided by the tier's interest day count, and rounded to the nearest cent once, on that final figure only.

## Commission rates of the interest table (percent)

| Accrued year | 2022 | 2023 | 2024 | 2025 | 2026 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Commission rate | 0.48 | 1.65 | 2.28 | 2.07 | 1.84 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical deposits, interest day count of 365)

| Last accrual period ends | Accrued year and period | Cash held | Rate | Days | Year-end interest |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| December 31, 2024 | 2025, January 1 through December 31 | $400.00 | 2.07 | 365 | $8.28 |
| December 31, 2023 | 2024, January 1 through December 31 | $300.00 | 2.28 | 366 | $6.86 |
| December 31, 2022 | 2023, January 1 through December 31 | $260.00 | 1.65 | 365 | $4.29 |

In the second row, $300.00 multiplied by 2.28 percent is $6.84; multiplied by 366 and divided by 365 it is $6.8587..., rounded once to $6.86.
